note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because the fault-report fields carry two shapes: `error_introduced` is `{step, kind, payload}` on 4532 records and `{step, kind, description}` on 182, and `diagnosis` / `propagation` / `recovery` / `verification` are a plain string on the majority but an object on that same 182-record family, so the datasets-server infers one shape from an early shard and then cannot cast the other. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on 4714 of 4722 records; always a string where present. The 8 records without it are cascading-error episodes, not the leftover-mill rows disclosed below

features.name: error_introduced
features.note: present on 4714 of 4722 records; always an object. Absent on the 8 leftover-mill rows disclosed below

struct.name: payload
struct.note: present on 4532 of the 4714; mutually exclusive with `description`

struct.name: description
struct.note: present on 182 of the 4714; mutually exclusive with `payload`. This is the pair the inferred schema died on

features.name: propagation
features.note: present on 2556 of 4722 records: a string on 2374, an object (`hops`, `survived_steps`, `mask`, `first_symptom_step`) on 182

features.name: diagnosis
features.note: present on 4714 of 4722 records: a string on 4532, an object (`step`, `how_survived`) on 182

features.name: recovery
features.note: present on 2556 of 4722 records: a string on 2374, an object (`step`, `action`) on 182

features.name: verification
features.note: present on 2556 of 4722 records: a string on 2374, an object (`step`, `evidence`) on 182

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`path`, `command`, `old`/`new`, `pattern`, `contents`, `cmd`, `old_string`/`new_string`, `diff`, `glob`)

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` on every record, plus `cascade_steps`, `recovered`, `tests_passed`, `diagnosis_hops`, `wasted_steps`, `residual`, `cost_steps`, `rows`, `handoff`, `xfailed` and single-record extras

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `domain`, `shop`, `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `product`, `mechanic` on subsets

disclosures.summary: Eight records that landed in rounds r2021-r2024 of this destination are leftover-mill designed episodes, not cascading-error episodes: `meta.kind` is `designed`, they carry `meta.product` / `meta.mechanic`, their goals are leftover / cache-miss goals, and they have no `error_introduced`, `diagnosis`, `propagation`, `recovery`, or `verification`. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: The other 4714 records are `cascading-error-recovery-factory` episodes generated by `grok-4.6`. They split into three shapes that are all published as generated: 2374 carry the string form of `propagation` / `diagnosis` / `recovery` / `verification`, 2158 carry only the string `diagnosis`, and 182 carry the object form of all four together with `error_introduced.description`.

Eight of those 4714 cascading-error episodes omit `plan` and nothing else: `cer-r57-ndots-search-double-append-a1`, `cer-r57-js-max-safe-int-order-id-b2`, `cer-r58-locale-comma-decimal-csv-e4`, `cer-r58-tar-strip-eats-prefix-f5`, `cer-r162-umask-group-writable-wheel-v3`, `cer-r162-csv-bom-skips-header-w8`, `cer-r196-symlink-follow-docker-copy-y1`, `cer-r196-make-tab-vs-spaces-partial-z2`.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
